title: Final Fight Revenge (Japan): built-in instruction edit
summary: Apply the upstream single-instruction workaround during sector delivery.
rationale: The menu unconditionally NOPs this instruction after the BIOS loads the first program. This exact-image recipe supplies that same program byte before loading; the original callback does not identify the underlying game failure.

writes.effect: Replace the SH-2 instruction at 0601199C with a NOP.
writes.reason: Preserve the built-in Final Fight Revenge edit without a menu RAM patch.
